user_story: As a guest, I want the system to reject a booking with 0 guests so that only valid guest counts are accepted.

positive.title: Booking with 1 guest successfully accepted
steps: Select 1 guest in the guest count dropdown
Fill in the required booking information
positive.expected_result: The booking is successfully created and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Booking with 0 guests is rejected
steps: Select 0 guests in the guest count dropdown
Fill in the required booking information
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the guest count must be greater than 0.

edge.title: Booking with negative guests is rejected
steps: Enter -1 in the guest count field
Fill in the required booking information
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the guest count must be a positive integer.
